expected.form: on the z-axis (x = y = 0) the field reduces to c + a*z - z^3/3 = 0, i.e. z^3 - 3a*z - 3c = 0; positive discriminant at canonical (a, c) gives three real on-axis fixed points

independent_reference.source: Field form per Aizawa, Y. (1982), Prog. Theor. Phys. 68 (1), 64-84, as cataloged in Sprott, J. C. (2003), 'Chaos and Time-Series Analysis' (ISBN 978-0-19-850839-7); canonical (a..f) = (0.95, 0.7, 0.6, 3.5, 0.25, 0.1) per the repo's algebraic anchor (algebraic.md section 4). The on-axis reduction is hand-derived in the derivation .md section 1; SymPy real_roots (generator) and numpy.roots (sim test) independently reproduce the three roots.
independent_reference.derived_by: hand reduction to the depressed cubic; SymPy real_roots; numpy.roots cross-check

expected.form: at (0, 0, z*) the Jacobian is block-diagonal: (x, y) block [[z-b, -d], [d, z-b]] gives (z - b) +/- d*i; the z-row gives a - z^2

independent_reference.source: Block-diagonal structure of J at on-axis points, hand-derived in the derivation .md section 2 (all x/y cross-terms of the z-row vanish at x = y = 0). SymPy eigenvals (generator) and numpy.linalg.eigvals on the full Jacobian (sim test) agree with the closed form.
independent_reference.derived_by: hand block-diagonal argument; SymPy eigenvals; numpy.linalg.eigvals cross-check

independent_reference.source: Trace of the hand-derived Jacobian (derivation .md section 3); the origin field value is read directly off the field definition (only the constant c survives at the origin). SymPy trace (generator) and central-difference divergence (sim PBT invariant) agree.
independent_reference.derived_by: hand trace; SymPy trace; central-difference PBT cross-check
